pattern: Verb Stem + ~는 바람에 (Because of / As a result of - Unexpected Negative Outcome)
meaningEn: Expressing cause/reason for an unexpected or negative result ('because / as a result of').
meaningId: Mengekspresikan alasan/sebab untuk hasil negatif atau tak terduga ('karena / gara-gara').

notesEn.formation: Verb Stem + ~는 바람에 (always uses present modifier ~는 regardless of tense).
notesEn.usage: Used when an unexpected event occurs, causing an unintended or negative outcome in the following clause.
notesEn.nuance: The final clause must be in past or present tense and usually describes an unwanted result or inconvenience.

notesId.formation: Kata Dasar Kata Kerja + ~는 바람에 (selalu menggunakan penjelas masa kini ~는 tanpa memandang bentuk waktu).
notesId.usage: Digunakan ketika peristiwa tak terduga terjadi, menyebabkan hasil yang tidak diinginkan pada klausa berikutnya.
notesId.nuance: Klausa akhir harus dalam bentuk lampau atau masa kini dan biasanya menggambarkan hasil yang tidak disukai.

examples.hangul: 갑자기 비가 오는 바람에 옷이 다 젖었어요.
examples.romaja: gap-ja-gi bi-ga o-neun ba-ram-e os-i da jeoj-eos-seo-yo.
examples.meaningEn: Because it rained suddenly, my clothes got completely wet.
examples.meaningId: Gara-gara hujan turun tiba-tiba, baju saya basah kuyup.

examples.meaningEn: Because I missed the bus, I was late.
examples.meaningId: Gara-gara ketinggalan bus, saya jadi terlambat.

examples.hangul: 늦잠을 자는 바람에 아침을 못 먹었어요.
examples.romaja: neut-jam-eul ja-neun ba-ram-e a-chim-eul mot meog-eos-seo-yo.
examples.meaningEn: Because I overslept, I couldn't eat breakfast.
examples.meaningId: Gara-gara bangun kesiangan, saya tidak bisa makan pagi.

quiz.question: Which connector is specifically used when an unexpected event leads to a negative outcome?
quiz.explanationEn: ~는 바람에 highlights that an unexpected reason directly caused an unwanted outcome.
quiz.explanationId: ~는 바람에 menekankan bahwa alasan tak terduga secara langsung menyebabkan hasil yang tidak diinginkan.

fillInTheBlank.sentenceEn: Because I missed the bus, I was late. -> 버스를 놓치___ 지각했어요.
fillInTheBlank.hintEn: Attach unexpected negative cause suffix to verb stem 놓치.
fillInTheBlank.hintId: Tempelkan akhiran sebab negatif tak terduga pada kata dasar 놓치.

constructionQuiz.promptEn: Translate to Korean: 'Because I missed the bus, I was late.'
constructionQuiz.promptId: Terjemahkan ke bahasa Korea: 'Gara-gara ketinggalan bus, saya jadi terlambat.'
constructionQuiz.hintEn: Use bus (버스를) + miss cause (놓치는 바람에) + late (지각했어요).
constructionQuiz.hintId: Gunakan bus (버스를) + alasan ketinggalan (놓치는 바람에) + terlambat (지각했어요).

pattern: Verb/Adj Stem + ~(으)ㄴ/는 탓에 (Blaming Cause 'Due to / Fault of')
meaningEn: Expressing blame or reason for a negative situation ('due to / all because of').
meaningId: Mengekspresikan alasan penyalahan atas situasi negatif ('akibat / kesalahan dari / gara-gara').

notesEn.formation: Present Verb: ~는 탓에 / Past Verb & Adj: ~(으)ㄴ 탓에 / Noun: Noun + 탓에.
notesEn.usage: Explicitly places the blame on a person, condition, or situation for a bad outcome.
notesEn.nuance: Stronger element of blame/fault compared to general reason connectors.

notesId.formation: Kata Kerja Present: ~는 탓에 / Kata Kerja Lampau & Kata Sifat: ~(으)ㄴ 탓에 / Kata Benda: Kata Benda + 탓에.
notesId.usage: Secara eksplisit menimpakan kesalahan pada seseorang, kondisi, atau situasi atas hasil yang buruk.
notesId.nuance: Memiliki unsur penyalahan/kesalahan yang lebih kuat dibandingkan kata penghubung alasan umum.

examples.meaningEn: Due to the cold weather, I caught a cold.
examples.meaningId: Akibat cuaca dingin, saya terkena flu.

examples.hangul: 어젯밤에 술을 많이 마신 탓에 머리가 아파요.
examples.romaja: eo-jet-bam-e sul-eul ma-ni ma-sin tas-e meo-ri-ga a-pa-yo.
examples.meaningEn: Because I drank a lot last night, my head hurts.
examples.meaningId: Gara-gara minum banyak semalam, kepala saya sakit.

examples.meaningEn: Due to the rain, the match was canceled.

quiz.question: What is the primary function of '~탓에'?
options: To blame a cause for a bad result
To express gratitude for a result
quiz.explanationEn: ~탓에 directly attributes blame (탓) to a cause for a negative situation.
quiz.explanationId: ~탓에 secara langsung menimpakan kesalahan (탓) pada suatu sebab atas situasi negatif.

fillInTheBlank.sentenceEn: Due to the cold weather, I caught a cold. -> 날씨가 추운 ___ 감기에 걸렸어요.
fillInTheBlank.hintEn: Insert blame/fault noun with locative particle.
fillInTheBlank.hintId: Masukan kata benda kesalahan/penyalahan dengan partikel tempat.

constructionQuiz.promptEn: Translate to Korean: 'Due to the cold weather, I caught a cold.'
constructionQuiz.promptId: Terjemahkan ke bahasa Korea: 'Akibat cuaca dingin, saya terkena flu.'
constructionQuiz.hintEn: Use weather (날씨가) + cold modifier (추운) + blame (탓에) + caught cold (감기에 걸렸어요).
constructionQuiz.hintId: Gunakan cuaca (날씨가) + penjelas dingin (추운) + akibat (탓에) + terkena flu (감기에 걸렸어요).

pattern: Verb/Adj Stem + ~(으)ㄹ 뿐이다 (Only / Nothing More Than)
meaningEn: Expressing that there is only one option or state ('only / just / nothing but').
meaningId: Mengekspresikan bahwa hanya ada satu pilihan atau kondisi ('hanya / cuma / tidak lain hanya').

notesEn.formation: Vowel stem -> ~ㄹ 뿐이다 / Consonant stem -> ~을 뿐이다. Noun: Noun + 일 뿐이다.
notesEn.usage: Emphasizes that something is limited strictly to what is stated, with no other additions.
notesEn.nuance: Synonymous with ~만 (only), but carries a more emphatic literary or formal tone.

notesId.formation: Kata Dasar berakhiran Vokal -> ~ㄹ 뿐이다 / Kata Dasar berakhiran Konsonan -> ~을 뿐이다. Kata Benda: Kata Benda + 일 뿐이다.
notesId.usage: Menekankan bahwa sesuatu dibatasi secara ketat hanya pada apa yang dinyatakan, tanpa ada tambahan lain.
notesId.nuance: Sinonim dengan ~만 (hanya), tetapi memiliki nada sastra atau formal yang lebih kuat.

examples.meaningEn: I just did what I was supposed to do.
examples.meaningId: Saya hanya melakukan apa yang harus saya lakukan.

examples.meaningEn: I will simply do my best.
examples.meaningId: Saya hanya akan melakukan yang terbaik.

quiz.question: Which construction means 'It is merely a rumor' using '소문'?
quiz.explanationEn: Attach ~일 뿐이에요 to noun 소문 to express 'nothing more than a rumor'.
quiz.explanationId: Tempelkan ~일 뿐이에요 pada kata benda 소문 untuk menyatakan 'tidak lain hanya rumor'.

fillInTheBlank.sentenceEn: It is merely a rumor. -> 소문일 ___이에요.
fillInTheBlank.hintId: Masukan kata benda terikat yang berarti 'hanya/sekadar'.

constructionQuiz.promptEn: Translate to Korean: 'It is merely a rumor.'
constructionQuiz.promptId: Terjemahkan ke bahasa Korea: 'Ini hanya sekadar rumor.'
constructionQuiz.hintEn: Use rumor (소문) + copula future modifier (일) + bound noun 'only' (뿐이에요).
constructionQuiz.hintId: Gunakan rumor (소문) + penjelas kopula (일) + kata benda terikat 'hanya' (뿐이에요).

pattern: Verb Stem + ~(으)ㄹ 수밖에 없다 (Have No Choice But To)
meaningEn: Expressing inevitability or having no choice ('have no choice but to do').
meaningId: Mengekspresikan keniscayaan atau tidak memiliki pilihan lain ('tidak ada pilihan selain').

notesEn.formation: Vowel stem -> ~ㄹ 수밖에 없다 / Consonant stem -> ~을 수밖에 없다.
notesEn.usage: Used when an action or state is unavoidable given the circumstances.
notesEn.nuance: Combines ~수 (way/ability) + ~밖에 없다 (nothing outside of this exists).

notesId.formation: Kata Dasar berakhiran Vokal -> ~ㄹ 수밖에 없다 / Kata Dasar berakhiran Konsonan -> ~을 수밖에 없다.
notesId.usage: Digunakan ketika suatu tindakan atau kondisi tidak dapat dihindari mengingat situasinya.
notesId.nuance: Menggabungkan ~수 (cara/kemampuan) + ~밖에 없다 (tidak ada hal lain di luar ini).

examples.hangul: 막차를 놓쳐서 택시를 탈 수밖에 없어요.
examples.romaja: mak-cha-reul nos-chyeo-seo taek-si-reul tal su-bak-e eobs-eo-yo.
examples.meaningEn: I missed the last train, so I have no choice but to take a taxi.
examples.meaningId: Saya ketinggalan kereta terakhir, jadi tidak ada pilihan selain naik taksi.

examples.hangul: 너무 비싸서 안 살 수밖에 없어요.
examples.romaja: neo-mu bi-ssa-seo an sal su-bak-e eobs-eo-yo.
examples.meaningEn: It is too expensive, so I have no choice but not to buy it.
examples.meaningId: Terlalu mahal, jadi mau tidak mau saya tidak membelinya.

examples.meaningEn: Since he studied hard, he is bound to succeed.
examples.meaningId: Karena dia belajar giat, dia pasti sukses (tidak ada pilihan selain sukses).

quiz.question: What does '택시를 탈 수밖에 없어요' mean?
options: I have no choice but to take a taxi
I want to take a taxi
quiz.explanationEn: ~(으)ㄹ 수밖에 없다 expresses that there is no other option available.
quiz.explanationId: ~(으)ㄹ 수밖에 없다 menyatakan bahwa tidak ada pilihan lain yang tersedia.

fillInTheBlank.sentenceEn: I have no choice but to take a taxi. -> 택시를 탈 수___ 없어요.
fillInTheBlank.hintEn: Insert particle meaning 'outside of / other than'.
fillInTheBlank.hintId: Masukan partikel yang berarti 'di luar / selain'.

constructionQuiz.promptEn: Translate to Korean: 'I missed the last train, so I have no choice but to take a taxi.'
constructionQuiz.promptId: Terjemahkan ke bahasa Korea: 'Saya ketinggalan kereta terakhir, jadi tidak ada pilihan selain naik taksi.'
constructionQuiz.answer: 막차를 놓쳐서 택시를 탈 수밖에 없어요

acceptableVariants: 막차를 놓쳐서 택시를 탈 수밖에 없습니다
constructionQuiz.hintEn: Use last train (막차를) + missed cause (놓쳐서) + taxi (택시를) + no choice but take (탈 수밖에 없어요).
constructionQuiz.hintId: Gunakan kereta terakhir (막차를) + alasan ketinggalan (놓쳐서) + taksi (택시를) + mau tak mau naik (탈 수밖에 없어요).

pattern: Verb/Adj Stem + ~(으)ㄹ 정도(로) (To the Extent That / So... That)
meaningEn: Expressing degree or extent ('to the point that / so much that').
meaningId: Mengekspresikan tingkat atau sejauh mana ('sampai-sampai / sedemikian rupa sehingga').

notesEn.formation: Vowel stem -> ~ㄹ 정도(로) / Consonant stem -> ~을 정도(로).
notesEn.usage: Describes the intensity of an action or situation by setting a comparative standard.
notesEn.nuance: ~정도 creates a noun phrase ('extent'), ~점으로/로 functions adverbially ('to the extent').

notesId.formation: Kata Dasar berakhiran Vokal -> ~ㄹ 정도(로) / Kata Dasar berakhiran Konsonan -> ~을 정도(로).
notesId.usage: Menggambarkan intensitas tindakan atau situasi dengan menetapkan standar perbandingan.
notesId.nuance: ~정도 membuat frasa kata benda ('tingkat'), ~점으로/로 berfungsi sebagai kata keterangan ('sampai sejauh').

examples.meaningEn: I was sad to the point of shedding tears.
examples.meaningId: Saya sangat sedih sampai-sampai meneteskan air mata.

examples.meaningEn: I screamed to the point that my voice went hoarse.
examples.meaningId: Saya berteriak sampai-sampai suara saya serak.

examples.meaningEn: We are friends to the extent that we see each other daily.
examples.meaningId: Kami adalah teman sampai pada tingkat bertemu setiap hari.

quiz.question: Which structure expresses 'to the extent that tears come out'?
quiz.explanationEn: ~(으)ㄹ 정도로 indicates degree or extent of an emotion or action.
quiz.explanationId: ~(으)ㄹ 정도로 menunjukkan tingkat atau sejauh mana suatu emosi atau tindakan.

constructionQuiz.promptId: Terjemahkan ke bahasa Korea: 'Saya sangat sedih sampai-sampai meneteskan air mata.'
constructionQuiz.hintEn: Use tears (눈물이) + flow modifier (날) + to the extent (정도로) + was sad (슬펐어요).
constructionQuiz.hintId: Gunakan air mata (눈물이) + penjelas keluar (날) + sampai-sampai (정도로) + sedih lampau (슬펐어요).
